items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:73:1
items.html: ZA has VAK of BON and VAK of MA: They are regarded as one body, like the MA and BON in the body of Aba, or the MA and BON in the body of Ima, where the MA is the male side in him and the BON is the female side in him, and they are attached to one another at an equal level. However, there is a great difference between the MA and BON in the body of ZA and the MA and BON in the bodies of AVI. For the MA and BON in the body of Aba are attached to one another face to face, which is a complete union; and likewise the MA and BON of Ima. But the MA and BON in the body of ZA stand back to back and are not regarded as a complete union, as above in the ARI’s words, page 663, item 64. And see there in the Inner Light.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:73:2
items.html: Just as ZA has in him HG, which are MA and BON, and so too in the Nukva: This does not contradict what the ARI wrote above (page 663, item 65), that ZA in its entirety is the discernment of MA and the Nukva in her entirety is the discernment of BON, as is well explained there in the Inner Light, see there.
